shared_elements: upright monolithic slab/stela with carved figural relief
anthropomorphic figure carved in low relief on a vertical stone face
frontal/vertical composition filling the stone surface
justification: Both depict an upright rounded-topped stone slab bearing a single anthropomorphic figure in low relief occupying the whole field, with head and headdress at the top and body elements below. However, A shows a densely packed, intricate composition with small dispersed motifs and possible glyph-like blocks along the edges, while B shows a very large, spare, simplified figure with a few bold concentric-disc and band motifs across the torso — the rendering conventions and level of detail differ sharply.
